detail.summary:
Completed both independent deliverables and verified them with real commands.

Files written:
- out/sum.txt: 44 (sum of 17, -4, 23, 8)
- out/words.txt: Apple, apple, fig, pear, plum (5 case-sensitive unique words, lexicographically sorted per ASCII, so Apple before apple)
- out/notes.txt: one line stating the numeric result (44) and the word count (5)

Commands run: workspace inspection (find/ls, read_file on data/a.txt and data/b.txt), a python3 heredoc that computed and wrote all three outputs, and independent shell cross-checks (awk sum -> 44; tr/sed/LC_ALL=C sort -u | wc -l -> 5 matching words.txt; test on sum.txt -> passed; ls -l out listing the three files).
evidence: tr -s '[:space:]' '\n' < data/b.txt | sed '/^$/d' | LC_ALL=C sort -u | wc -l -> 5
ls -l out -> notes.txt, sum.txt, words.txt present
